The regional entry specifies 5 sqm per guest for certain net-use areas, not a minimum gross property area; it also lists autonomous-center capacity of 10–25 guests and net useful-area standards for an infirmary and gym. Urban-planning compatibility, change-of-use approval, accessibility, technical suitability, and sector authorization require verification. The low envelope and renewables energy subscores temper the otherwise favorable energy class.
